canonical_hash_recipe: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, compact comma/colon separators. File hashes bind exact bytes.

closed_flags_contract.note: Retain complete current plan identity/restart/execution_holds/shared_execution_holds_apply values, including owner-capture hold. No invented open file, owner absence, identity or execution claim.

frozen_baseline.counts_origin: Read from pinned existing validation, not remeasured. No future combined total claimed.

remaining_pair_hold.reason: Two explicit personal role credits are supported, but complete personal family/given boundaries are not established by the original source or existing exact profile. The modern API contract has no approved literal name-only personal projection. A source-supported part annotation or newly reviewed explicit name-boundary interpretation is needed; no such decision is made here.
remaining_pair_hold.reopen_only_with: Separate source-supported personal family/given-part review for both whole credits; no implementation guess or combined Organization fallback.

required_future_implementation_evidence_: Reviewed runtime implementation and finalized immutable manifest pins
Fresh two-member source assessments, v1 policies, v2 class artifacts and complete metadata equality under explicit assessment time
Independent implementation review and appropriate guarded offline tests
Fresh reproducible preparation/compatibility receipts before any new coverage claim

reviewed_eligibility.review_scope: Reconciled existing review membership and metadata against current pinned JSON; no original XML/evidence re-review or fresh source classification.

runtime_manifest_contract.activation: No loader currently consumes this draft. Root must deliberately derive/review/pin the eventual repository manifest and code. Copy source review and subordinate receipts unchanged if vendorized; retain their hashes.
